Be careful!! This app shows a lower Avg buying price from the price you actually bought at, under your Holdings section, in Delivery orders. It thereby encourages you to sell at a lower price or less margin. This way u loose net money in the sale, since sell when price is lower too , but Groww makes money on brokerages. Effectively u are losing money. Since most Groww users are not exactly regular traders, we dont keep track of the exact price we bought, and Groww cheats its customers this way!!

This lack of proper communication seriously damages customer trust.
